Last week, Vice President Vance said on the @willcain show: "That's goal number one. Keep oil and gas cheap for Americans all over our country." --- Note that he said goal number two was stopping Iran from getting a nuclear weapon. This is consistent with the view I picked up from @Geo_papic ... oil is the independent variable in the war, not the dependent variable. This means @potus wakes up every morning, looks at the price of oil, and that dictates his prosecution of the war. Not the war dictates where the price of oil will go. @potus is trying to manage oil prices first, the war second. Understanding this will clear up a lot of the confusion about oil price movements. The market knows how to get @potus to react, move the price of oil. Not the other way around.
